phy.source: 3.5 ns measured FDI-to-FDI, IEEE JSSC 2026 doi:10.1109/JSSC.2026.3651425 (registry sct:r-ucie-jssc26) -> 4.2 -> 5 cycles at 1.2 GHz; best 3 (CPMT 2022 bound), worst 9 (2x measured, phy json)

modelled.die_seam_stages: register chains at the die depth (dv2f14bn fwd_lanes E 2 / kvs14c die.v relay chains); the positive runs equalise each bundle to its netlisted maximum (PLAN)
modelled.stimuli: slice Q/K/V dd words, HOST context, sys_face slots, KV layer-programme authority, PV final join result beats: compiled stimuli at the native59 / programme pins

exchanges.name: C2K CMD + 32 Q (native59 -> KV attention programme)
exchanges.definition: last Q beat issue at native59 native_tx_v -> that beat at the programme q_valid (CMD: issue -> request_valid)
exchanges.O_source: compiler token path: attn_kv window serial after qknorm_rope; no independent compute op scheduled inside it
exchanges.grade: measured-current-RTL (composed vc+vk; full-pair co-sim blocked, see findings)

exchanges.name: K2C 32 RESULT + STATUS (KV attention programme -> native59 -> DV return chain)
exchanges.definition: last RESULT beat issue at the programme tx_valid -> that beat at native59 dr_o
exchanges.O_source: compiler token path: o_proj starts after attn_kv (serial)

exchanges.name: KVN 4 words (new K/V, native59 formatter -> KV d2d KVN word)
exchanges.O_meas: hidden: consumed by the next token attention (layer period 6835 edges >> KVN latency)

layer_attention_segment.note: q0 = the compiled CMD slot (end of qknorm_rope); priced = the d2d_link_calendar image with zero-latency component codecs (vk_abut reproduces it). Abutted real producers (vc_abut/vk_abut): +4.

composition.formula: T_token += sum_l n_l * max(0, E_meas - O_meas)  (exchanges above; n_l = 1 per decode layer)
composition.layers_covered: L1..L35 (segment 0, identical windows); L0 (token-run window 2038) NOT run: see findings F7
composition.usage: with TOKEN-PASS-QWEN C_die(l) terms that exclude every D2D leg (compute die to the Q issue / from the dr_o land; KV die C_kv = programme CMD land -> last RESULT issue = 1779, fixed by SERVICE_END 1777): add per_layer_exposed. If C_die keeps the priced attn_kv window (1816), add vs_priced_token_path instead.
